# Rabbit Holes

> A public commonplace book by Bhuvanesh: links, quotes, poems, reflections, and long-form, cited visual explainers — kept in the open.

Rabbit Holes is a personal commonplace book and digital garden published by Bhuvanesh ("Bhuvan"). It gathers the interesting, useful, and strange things he finds on the internet, in five forms: musings, links, reflections, verse, and practical notes. The work sits on three shelves:

- **Folios** — the running linkblog and commonplace entries (the main feed).
- **Explainers** — long, sourced visual essays that answer a single question properly (for example, where the elements come from). Every quantitative claim is cited to a primary source.
- **Study notes** — reviewed summaries produced in conversation with an AI, each one pointing back to the source it was built from and naming the model used.

Everything is written in plain language and published openly: no tracking, no newsletter modal, no paywall. RSS is the quiet way to follow along.

Author: Bhuvan (https://twitter.com/bebhuvan)

## Sections

- [Home](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/): The latest folios and an entry point into the book.
- [Explainers](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/explainers): Long-form, cited visual essays.
- [Study Notes](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/study-notes): AI-assisted notes, each reviewed against its source.
- [Subjects](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/heads): Hand-chosen subjects threading through the folios.
- [Collections](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/collections): A curated place to start.
- [Archive](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/archive): Every folio in order.
- [Tags](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/tags): Normalized tags across the corpus.
- [Blogroll](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/blogroll): Independent blogs Bhuvan recommends.
- [Search](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/search): Search titles, subjects, and text.
- [About](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/about): Who keeps this, and why.
- [RSS feed](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/rss.xml): New folios and explainers as they are published.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.rabbitholes.garden/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of every page.
- [Source](https://github.com/bebhuvan): The author's GitHub.
